elements.title: Why should a chart not rely only on color to distinguish categories?

elements.title: What can happen when fixed-width content is enlarged?

answer_key.q4: Some users cannot perceive the color difference
answer_key.q5: Content can be clipped or require unnecessary horizontal scrolling

explanations.q1: A useful alternative communicates the relevant purpose or information.
explanations.q2: Captions communicate audio content in synchronized text.
explanations.q3: A label association makes the relationship programmatically available.
explanations.q4: Additional visible cues can communicate distinctions without relying on color alone.
explanations.q5: Layouts should be tested at applicable resize and reflow conditions.
